# Standalone CMakeLists.txt for FMA test
# Usage:
#   mkdir build_test && cd build_test
#   cmake -f ../test_fma_CMakeLists.txt ..
#   cmake --build .
#   ./test_fma ../testdata

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(FlexFloatFMATest C)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 99)

# FlexFloat configuration is read from include/flexfloat_config.h
# (included by flexfloat.h automatically)

# Include directories
include_directories(${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/include)

# Build test executable
add_executable(test_fma
    test_fma.c
    src/flexfloat.c
)

# Link math library (Linux/macOS)
if(UNIX)
    target_link_libraries(test_fma m)
endif()

# Copy testdata for convenience
add_custom_command(TARGET test_fma POST_BUILD
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/testdata
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/testdata
    COMMENT "Copying testdata to build directory"
)
